method.central_question: Does the Decision Trail specialist setup resist obvious over-inference and overtrust traps before it tries to fill messy interpretation fields?
dry_run_parts: trap discipline dry run over PR92 traps
packet-surface dry run over the two PR91 report packet targets
method.codex_use: Current-session Codex reasoning filled this provisional review fixture. No provider calls, repo-wired model calls, runtime calls, or archive reads were performed.
source_policy: Use PR92 traps as synthetic contract expectations, not human labels.
Use PR91 packet fixture as checked-in-safe packet surface.
Do not read raw transcripts, raw revised answers, raw memos, provider text, private ledgers, or local private archive payloads.
Do not fill PR90 specialist output fields from checked-in-safe packet context.

results.expected_future_behavior: Stay blocked, unclear, or private-needed when safe fixture context lacks the actual decision-story basis.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Kept report existence and packet completeness separate from interpretation readiness.
Preserved source_report_not_checked_in and safe_fixture_only as limitations.
Refused to fill likely action or assistant influence from artifact presence.
uncertainty_notes: This is a synthetic trap, not a real archive read.
A future dry run should keep blocked_thin_context explicit in any contract-shaped output.
results.human_or_private_followup: Inspect raw conversation and revised answer before deciding whether any candidate interpretation exists.

results.expected_future_behavior: Keep custody health separate from conversation understanding and advice usefulness.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Treated clean custody as inspection readiness only.
Kept messy interpretation fields unfilled.
Preserved the non-claim that clean artifacts do not mean good advice.
uncertainty_notes: A clean shell is still valuable, but only as process visibility.
The trap does not test whether a real conversation was understood.
results.human_or_private_followup: Review interpretation adequacy separately from artifact health.

results.expected_future_behavior: Treat structural_delta as source material, not improvement or usefulness.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Preserved structural_delta as an overtrust-risk section.
Required likely-action and lost-value reads before any stronger interpretation.
Kept useful/noisy friction unresolved.
uncertainty_notes: A structural change can be real and still not decision-useful.
This trap should remain active before any future fan-in summary.
results.human_or_private_followup: Check whether structural_delta changed action, threshold, sequence, gate, or merely language.

results.expected_future_behavior: Preserve that PR88 generated report JSON was not checked in.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Kept PR88 durable review findings as summary context only.
Did not pretend the generated Decision Trail report was present.
Carried source_report_not_checked_in into packet-surface dry-run limits.
uncertainty_notes: The generated report could be regenerated locally, but that did not happen in PR93.
Review summaries are not equivalent to full report contents.
results.human_or_private_followup: Regenerate or inspect the report locally before using report-level field details.

results.expected_future_behavior: Use unclear or private-needed for likely actions when action basis is unavailable.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Blocked likely-action reads on both PR91 report targets.
Did not infer action delta from structural_delta.
Kept action, threshold, sequence, evidence-gate, and stop-rule deltas unfilled.
uncertainty_notes: The setup can avoid obvious over-inference here.
A future local-private pass is still needed to test whether it can identify likely actions correctly.
results.human_or_private_followup: Compare actual vanilla and revised answer surfaces before filling likely action fields.

results.expected_future_behavior: Preserve option-status uncertainty and avoid narrowing the decision without evidence.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Marked option status as unavailable in checked-in-safe packet context.
Preserved live-option uncertainty in fan-in notes.
Did not collapse the decision to one option.
uncertainty_notes: The trap can force option uncertainty, but cannot test whether a future specialist detects subtle option loss.
Safe fixtures do not reveal whether an option was user-rejected or system-lost.
results.human_or_private_followup: Inspect conversation turns to determine option status before narrowing the decision question.

results.expected_future_behavior: Mark assistant influence unavailable or private-needed when checked-in-safe context lacks turn detail.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Kept assistant influence out of populated fields.
Marked assistant influence as needing bounded interpretation or private context.
Did not infer no influence from absence.
uncertainty_notes: The dry run can preserve the missingness, but cannot prove the future specialist can detect influence in real transcripts.
Checked-in-safe context compresses away stance shifts.
results.human_or_private_followup: Inspect turn-level conversation history for assistant reframing and user adoption or resistance.

results.expected_future_behavior: Preserve lost-value risk instead of assuming none exists because custody is clean.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Kept lost_value blocked by missing raw/revised context.
Preserved possible speed, simplicity, agency, and ambition loss as follow-up concerns.
Did not treat more caution as automatically safer.
uncertainty_notes: Lost-value categories are possible concerns, not findings.
A future specialist must ground lost value in actual source context.
results.human_or_private_followup: Compare original and revised answer nuance against the user's stated priorities.

results.expected_future_behavior: Preserve disagreement and not-ready fields; no voting, averaging, or neat verdict.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Kept fan-in limited to preserving gaps and next-review priorities.
Did not create a net decision read from partial role readiness.
Preserved local-private need and source-report thinness.
uncertainty_notes: This dry run does not test a real conflict among completed specialist outputs because no contract-shaped specialist outputs were created.
Future fan-in remains a high-risk authority-leak point.
results.human_or_private_followup: Review completed specialist reads side by side before any fan-in summary is trusted.

results.expected_future_behavior: Mark private-needed fields as private-needed, not missing and not solved.
observed_codex_assisted_behavior: Preserved local_private_shadow_review:not_run.
Kept raw conversation, raw revised answer, memo nuance, and private ledgers out of checked-in outputs.
Blocked likely-action and lost-value reads that require private context.
uncertainty_notes: The dry run can preserve the status, but local_private_mode is still not implemented.
Until local-private packet mode exists, this cannot test the real private-read workflow.
results.human_or_private_followup: Decide whether to implement a local-private packet mode before attempting real Decision Trail interpretation.

summary.strongest_useful_signal: The dry run preserved safe_fixture_only, source_report_not_checked_in, local_private_shadow_review:not_run, interpretation-needed sections, and structural_delta overtrust risk instead of treating PR91 packets as semantic evidence.
summary.strongest_remaining_risk: The dry run still uses checked-in-safe fixture surfaces, not full local-private conversation context, so it can test review discipline but not real interpretation adequacy.
